value.note: Entry B-7 records an attempted diameter measurement of the disk in tray K, but the calibration failed. The only retained blurred scale image is consistent with readings from 17 mm through 19 mm, and the bench record states that this attempted measurement cannot settle the exact diameter; no reliable replacement measurement is available. Therefore the extract does not establish the statement "The disk in tray K has a diameter of 18 mm." It can only support that 18 mm is within the broad range consistent with the retained image (17–19 mm), not that the exact diameter is 18 mm. The material limits are the failed calibration, the blurred and non-unique scale image, and the absence of a reliable replacement measurement.
